source_refs.note: Exercise 11.1, Question 2 (book page 205): periods of 11 functions, parts (i)-(xi). Answer key PDF 309 prints 2pi/3 for (i) and 40/pi for (v); correct values 2pi/5 and 40. Solution book PDF 996-1003.

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the periods of the following functions: \(\sin 5x\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sine function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle sine ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sin 5x\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: sine, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = 5\]
Kyun: Angle \(5x\) hai, yani \(x\) jitna barhe, angle us se 5 guna tez barhta hai. Angle ko poora chakkar \(2\pi\) lagane ke liye \(x\) ko sirf \(2\pi \div 5\) barhna parta hai. Jaise tez chalne wali ghari ki suii jaldi chakkar poora karti hai.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{5}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin 5\left(x + \dfrac{2\pi}{5}\right)\]
\[= \sin(5x + 2\pi)\]
\[= \sin 5x\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur sine \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke sine ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein part (i) ka jawab \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) chhapa hai, jo misprint hai. \(\sin 5x\) mein \(x\) ka coefficient 5 hai, is liye period \(\frac{2\pi}{5}\) hai. \(2\pi/3\) to \(\sin 3x\) ka period hota. Check: \(\sin 5(x + 2\pi/3) = \sin(5x + 10\pi/3)\), aur \(10\pi/3\) \(2\pi\) ka multiple nahi, is liye yeh period nahi ho sakta.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the periods of the following functions: \(\cos 7x\).

Plan: pehle cosine ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.

Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \cos 7x\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: cosine, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = 7\]
Kyun: Cosine bhi sine ki tarah \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. 7 ka matlab hai ke \(0\) se \(2\pi\) ke darmiyan graph 7 poore chakkar (cycles) lagata hai, is liye ek chakkar \(2\pi/7\) ka.

\[\text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{7}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 7\left(x + \dfrac{2\pi}{7}\right)\]
\[= \cos(7x + 2\pi)\]
\[= \cos 7x\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur cosine \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke cosine ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: tangent, basic period \(\pi\).
\[c = 3\]
Kyun: Yahan sab se aham baat: tangent ka basic period \(\pi\) hai, \(2\pi\) nahi (Theorem 11.2). Is liye \(\pi\) ko 3 se divide karenge.

\[\text{Period} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.

\[\tan 3\left(x + \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)\]
\[= \tan(3x + \pi)\]
\[= \tan 3x\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(\pi\) jama hota hai, aur tangent \(\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke tangent ka sab se chhota period \(\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Find the periods of the following functions: \(\cot \frac{x}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh cotangent function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle cotangent ka basic period (\(\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \cot \frac{x}{2}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: cotangent, basic period \(\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(c = 1/2\) hai, jo 1 se chhota hai. Angle \(x\) se aadhi raftaar se chalta hai, is liye graph phail (stretch) jata hai aur period \(\pi\) se lamba, yani \(2\pi\), ho jata hai. Divide by \(1/2\) ka matlab multiply by 2.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = \pi \div \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[= \pi \times 2 = 2\pi\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\cot \dfrac{x + 2\pi}{2}\]
\[= \cot\left(\dfrac{x}{2} + \pi\right)\]
\[= \cot \dfrac{x}{2}\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(\pi\) jama hota hai, aur cotangent \(\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke cotangent ka sab se chhota period \(\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Find the periods of the following functions: \(19\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{20}x\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sine function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle sine ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 19\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{20}x\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: sine, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{\pi}{20}\]
Kyun: 19 sirf lehar ki unchai (amplitude) barhata hai; lehar kitni dafa dohrayi jati hai is par koi asar nahi. \(c\) mein bhi \(\pi\) hai aur \(2\pi\) mein bhi, is liye dono \(\pi\) cancel ho jate hain aur period saada number 40 bachta hai, \(\pi\) ke baghair.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = 2\pi \div \dfrac{\pi}{20}\]
\[= 2\pi \times \dfrac{20}{\pi}\]
\[= 40\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{\pi}{20}(x + 40) = \dfrac{\pi x}{20} + 2\pi\]
\[19\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{20} + 2\pi\right) = 19\sin\dfrac{\pi x}{20}\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur sine \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke sine ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein part (v) ka jawab \(\frac{40}{\pi}\) chhapa hai, jo ghalat hai. \(2\pi \div \frac{\pi}{20} = 2\pi \times \frac{20}{\pi} = 40\); dono \(\pi\) cancel ho jate hain. Check: \(x\) mein 40 jama karein to angle mein \(\frac{\pi}{20} \times 40 = 2\pi\) jama hota hai, jabke \(\frac{40}{\pi}\) jama karne se sirf 2 radian. Sahi period 40 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Find the periods of the following functions: \(\operatorname{cosec}\left(\frac{2x}{5}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh cosecant function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle cosecant ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \operatorname{cosec}\left(\frac{2x}{5}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: cosecant, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{2}{5}\]
Kyun: Cosecant \(1/\sin\) hai, is liye jab sine dohraya jata hai, cosecant bhi dohraya jata hai. Is ka basic period bhi \(2\pi\) hai. Fraction se divide karna = us ke ulte (reciprocal) se multiply karna.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = 2\pi \div \dfrac{2}{5}\]
\[= 2\pi \times \dfrac{5}{2} = 5\pi\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{2}{5}(x + 5\pi) = \dfrac{2x}{5} + 2\pi\]
\[\operatorname{cosec}\left(\dfrac{2x}{5} + 2\pi\right) = \operatorname{cosec}\dfrac{2x}{5}\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur cosecant \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke cosecant ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (vii) Find the periods of the following functions: \(\frac{1}{2}\sin\left(\frac{3x}{2} - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sine function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle sine ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{2}\sin\left(\frac{3x}{2} - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: sine, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: Aage wala \(\tfrac12\) sirf unchai badalta hai, aur andar wala \(-\tfrac{\pi}{2}\) graph ko sirf daayen baayen khiskata (shift karta) hai. Lehar ki lambai sirf \(x\) ke coefficient \(3/2\) se tay hoti hai. Shift karne se lehar ki lambai nahi badalti, jaise kisi rassi ko khiskane se us ki lambai nahi badalti.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = 2\pi \div \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[= 2\pi \times \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{3}{2}\left(x + \dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right) - \dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{3x}{2} - \dfrac{\pi}{2} + 2\pi\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur sine \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke sine ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (viii) Find the periods of the following functions: \(-5 - 3\sec\left(7\pi x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).

steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -5 - 3\sec\left(7\pi x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: secant, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = 7\pi\]
Kyun: Secant \(1/\cos\) hai, basic period \(2\pi\). \(-5\) graph ko neeche le jata hai, \(-3\) us ko ulta aur lamba karta hai, \(+\pi/4\) khiskata hai: in mein se koi period nahi badalta. \(c = 7\pi\) mein \(\pi\) hai, is liye jawab mein \(\pi\) cancel ho jata hai.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{7\pi}\]
\[= \dfrac{2}{7}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[7\pi\left(x + \dfrac{2}{7}\right) + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[= 7\pi x + \dfrac{\pi}{4} + 2\pi\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur secant \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke secant ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (x) Find the periods of the following functions: \(6 - 4\cot\left(\frac{7x}{4} + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh cotangent function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle cotangent ka basic period (\(\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 6 - 4\cot\left(\frac{7x}{4} + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: cotangent, basic period \(\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{7}{4}\]
Kyun: Cotangent ka basic period bhi tangent ki tarah \(\pi\) hai. 6, \(-4\) aur \(+\pi/4\) ko nazar andaz karein; sirf \(x\) ka coefficient \(7/4\) kaam ka hai.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = \pi \div \dfrac{7}{4}\]
\[= \pi \times \dfrac{4}{7} = \dfrac{4\pi}{7}\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{7}{4}\left(x + \dfrac{4\pi}{7}\right) + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{7x}{4} + \dfrac{\pi}{4} + \pi\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(\pi\) jama hota hai, aur cotangent \(\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke cotangent ka sab se chhota period \(\pi\) hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (xi) Find the periods of the following functions: \(9 + 30\sec\left(\frac{x}{15} + \frac{2\pi}{15}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh secant function hai. Period woh sab se chhoti positive lambai \(p\) hai jis ke baad graph hoobahoo dohraya jata hai, yani \(f(x + p) = f(x)\).
Plan: pehle secant ka basic period (\(2\pi\)) yaad karenge, phir \(x\) ka coefficient \(c\) dhoondenge, divide karenge aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 9 + 30\sec\left(\frac{x}{15} + \frac{2\pi}{15}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f\) ka period.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\operatorname{cosec}\) ka basic period \(2\pi\) hai; \(\tan\), \(\cot\) ka basic period \(\pi\) hai. \(a + b\,\mathrm{T}(cx + d)\) shakal ke function (T yani koi bhi trigonometric function) ka period = basic period \(\div |c|\). \(a\) graph ko upar neeche, \(b\) us ki unchai, aur \(d\) us ko daayen baayen karta hai; in mein se koi bhi period nahi badalta. Formula ki wajah: angle \(cx + d\) ko poora basic period barhna chahiye, aur \(x\) ke barhne se angle \(c\) guna barhta hai.

Function aur \(c\) pehchanein
Function: secant, basic period \(2\pi\).
\[c = \dfrac{1}{15}\]
Kyun: Yahan \(c = 1/15\) bohat chhota hai, yani angle bohat aahista chalta hai. Is liye graph bohat phail jata hai aur period lamba, \(30\pi\), ho jata hai. Dhyan rahe: \(x/15\) ka coefficient \(1/15\) hai, 15 nahi.

Basic period ko \(c\) se divide karein
\[\text{Period} = 2\pi \div \dfrac{1}{15}\]
\[= 2\pi \times 15 = 30\pi\]
Kyun: angle ko ek poora basic period barhna hai. Angle \(x\) se \(c\) guna tez chalta hai, is liye \(x\) ko sirf basic period \(\div c\) chalna parta hai.
Dhyan dein: sine, cosine, secant, cosecant ke liye \(2\pi\) aur tangent, cotangent ke liye \(\pi\). Yahi do number ulat jayein to jawab dugna ya aadha ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{x + 30\pi}{15} + \dfrac{2\pi}{15}\]
\[= \dfrac{x}{15} + \dfrac{2\pi}{15} + 2\pi\]
Kyun: \(x\) mein period jama karne se angle mein theek \(2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur secant \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraya jata hai. Is se chhota koi positive number kaam nahi karta, kyunke secant ka sab se chhota period \(2\pi\) hi hai.
